fact: The Association of Online Press Publishers and Professionals (APPEL), a Senegalese professional body, with Paradigm Initiative, backed 23 MPs' constitutional challenge lodged on 10 March 2026 against the media regulator law (CNRM law) over risks of administrative censorship; the document is Paradigm Initiative's account.
RSF says that in early 2024 restrictions such as internet shutdowns undermined the right to inform in Senegal; who ordered them and how long they lasted are not stated.

CIPESA says shutdowns were imposed in Senegal during the 2023 unrest, and a court (not named as ECOWAS in the passage) found they violated freedom of expression and access to information; who ordered them is not stated.

Le Soleil reports journalist Bachir Fofana was held from 25 June 2025, placed under committal and tried on 2 July 2025 for spreading false news, and commentator Badara Gadiaga was jailed from 14 July 2025 over remarks about Ousmane Sonko.
